workflow_steps.title: Align second elevation raster to first raster grid
workflow_steps.purpose: Create a grid-aligned version of input_2 suitable for raster arithmetic with input_1.
workflow_steps.instructions: Resample input_2 to the exact grid definition of input_1, including its 30 m resolution, grid origin, extent, and CRS. Preserve the elevation values and output a GeoTIFF raster.

workflow_steps.title: Calculate elevation difference
workflow_steps.purpose: Compute the raster difference between the two elevation surfaces.
workflow_steps.instructions: Calculate input_1 minus aligned_input_2 on a cell-by-cell basis. Produce a GeoTIFF raster containing the elevation difference and preserve the aligned grid and CRS.

requirements.scope: The aligned_input_2 output must have the same raster grid definition as input_1, including resolution, origin, extent, and cell alignment.

input_1 and aligned_input_2 must have compatible grid definitions before raster arithmetic.
input_1 and aligned_input_2 must use compatible CRSs for raster calculation.
